senses.gloss: (denom. of תְּרוּעָה), Hif. הִתְרִיעַ to sound alarm, esp. to blow the Shofar at public services (at fast and prayer meetings &c.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1:10">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ</cite> top <he>כל שנה שאין מַתְרִיעִין … שמתריעין לה בסופה</he> if people neglect to blow the Shofar at the beginning of the year, they will sound it at the end, v. <cite ref="T00415"><he>רוּעַ</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:1">Taan. III, 1</cite> <he>צמחים ששנו מתריעין עליהם מיד</he> when plants change (degenerate), we blow (call prayer meetings) for them at once (without waiting for the first rain).

<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>אותה העיר מתענה ומַתְרַעַת … ומַתְרִיעוֹת</he> that town must fast and blow the Shofar (at prayer meeting), and all those around must fast, but not hold prayer meetings; <he>מתריעות ולא מתענות</he> must hold prayer meetings, but not fast. Ib. 7 <he>על אלו מתריעין בשבת וכ׳</he> on the following occasions the alarm is sounded on the Sabbath: when a city is surrounded by gentiles, or threatened with a flood, &c., v. <cite ref="I00859"><he>טָרַף</he></cite>; a. fr.
